attempts.summary: Configured NFS sharing between node1 (server, RHEL 7.9) and node2 (client, RHEL 7.9) using a shared dataops identity (UID/GID 4500) on both hosts. node1 exports /srv/nfs/shared (owned dataops:dataops, mode 2770) via NFSv4.1 restricted to node2's IP with root_squash; node2 mounts it persistently at /mnt/shared via /etc/fstab. Verified bidirectional writes preserve dataops:dataops ownership and 2770 permissions. Completed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on both nodes: captured healthy baselines, rebooted one node at a time via systemctl reboot, confirmed changed boot_id on each, and verified full recovery of the NFS export/mount and data integrity after each restart.
